resolved_findings.finding: The web runtime used only process-local shared state and restart proof used manual export/import.
resolved_findings.resolution: The Node fixture server now owns an atomic file-backed persistence adapter and a fresh store reconstructs admissions, singleton session, immutable pair, queue, versions, and audit from the persisted snapshot.

resolved_findings.finding: Fixture admission trusted client-supplied verification facts and email/password had no password proof.
resolved_findings.resolution: The server now issues deterministic one-time fixture credentials, persists only hashes, validates email/password and Google assertion server-side, and no longer accepts a client emailVerified claim.

resolved_findings.finding: A public repository method could create admission directly and the database did not enforce admission-to-redemption linkage.
resolved_findings.resolution: Direct registration was removed; admission is reachable only through atomic invite redemption, and migration 0017 adds the app_admissions invite_redemption_id foreign key after legacy-safe backfill.

resolved_findings.finding: CURRENT_STATE and original acceptance evidence used a prose commit placeholder and pre-CP-02 last-good commit.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current context pins the exact implementation and audit-fix commits and points to this immutable re-audit evidence.

resolved_findings.finding: The first audit could not complete fresh canonical verification because the local disk returned ENOSPC.
resolved_findings.resolution: A fresh exact-commit canonical run subsequently completed with exit zero, including installed real Chrome.

validated_invariants: gated one-time email-bound admission with atomic consumption
GPU selection only while truly idle
global waiting-only reorder and remove with actor plus old/new order audit
one active video and inert waiting work
no active Serverless, Auto, AvatarForcing, MuseTalk, SkyReels, repair, fallback, or legacy dispatch path in canonical composition
isolated lane volume, Pod, artifact, scratch, and callback contracts
queue-drain requires both lane Pods absent while intended volumes remain
